verdict.rationale: The documentation index links a first-party 'Migrate' section at /docs/molt/migration-overview, which shows a documented migration path exists. Nothing in the pack describes its import mechanics or any minimal-downtime approach such as replication or cutover. PostgreSQL wire compatibility and outbound changefeeds are adjacent features and are not credited. Missing for 10: evidence of how the import from an existing production database works, a documented minimal-downtime or cutover method, supported source databases, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can import an existing production database with minimal downtime using a documented migration path
